messages:
Jordan: Alerting — multiple customers reporting dropped SSE/stream connections and 502/503s from edge-proxy-us-west after a cert hot-reload at 09:12 UTC. Posting status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2865432100 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2865432100 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/edge-streaming-leaks. Pager notified to oncall.
Eve (oncall): Acknowledged. Gathering connection metrics and heap stats from edge-proxy fleet. Initial signal: connection counts steadily increasing on proxies that observed the hot-reload; memory usage climbing and occasional worker OOMs.
Priya: Infra: looks like the reload path didn't fully re-register old keepalive handlers, causing file descriptor leaks on the workers. Rolling restart of affected proxies planned. Spinning a small canary restart first.
SRE-Bot: Canary restart initiated for edge-proxy-usw-3. Healthchecks running. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2865432100/canary
Eve (oncall): Canary restart successful, connections rebalanced and memory dropped. Proceeding to rolling restart across the pool with 1/10 surge capacity to avoid customer impact.
Jordan: Mitigation steps: 1) roll restart edge-proxy-us-west (canary succeeded) 2) temporarily lower SSE keepalive timeout to reduce leaked connections 3) enable connection soft-limit per-tenant to stop noisy clients.
Priya: Applied keepalive timeout reduction and connection soft-limits (policy id: sse-softlimit-0326). Rolling restarts in progress (4/10 completed). Early metrics: 503s drop from ~7.6% -> ~1.9% after first 3 restarts.
CS: Drafting customer blurb: "We experienced intermittent streaming disconnects in us-west after an edge cert reload; we restarted affected proxies and applied mitigations — traffic is recovering." Approve to publish?
Jordan: Approved. Add note recommending clients reconnect and enable exponential backoff. We'll include links to status page and ETA for final update.
Eve (oncall): Observed one noisy tenant causing high connection churn on proxy 7; throttling that tenant temporarily to stabilize. If the tenant needs help, route to CS.
SRE-Bot: Update INC-2865432100: rolling restart 6/10 completed, mitigations active, monitoring. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/85432  logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2865432100
Priya: After restart fleet mem usage normalized and connection counts dropped to baseline. A small number of long-lived streams will need client reconnection; no data loss expected.
Jordan: Next steps: keep the soft-limits/keepalive changes for 2h, follow-up with a safe cert-reload fix (add handler re-registration and FD leak tests to the rotation job). Create ENGTASK for cert-rotation hardening.
CS: Notifying impacted customers and offering assistance for reconnect strategies.
Eve (oncall): Preliminary status: mitigations restored connectivity for most customers; continuing 1h observation. Preparing RCA stub: root cause: cert hot-reload path left stale keepalive handlers leading to FD leak and eventual worker exhaustion.
Jordan: Exec one-liner: "Short-lived streaming disconnects in us-west caused by edge cert reload leaving stale handlers; rolling restarts and soft-limits restored service; detailed RCA forthcoming." :white_check_mark:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2865432100: mitigations applied, monitoring. Tagging logs/traces with INC-2865432100 for postmortem correlation.
Priya: Thanks team — will follow up with remediation PR and add preflight FD leak checks to rotation CI. Closing thread once stable for 1h.
